title: Hartogs comparison with the actual algebra pushforward
statement:
theorem depth_two_hartogs_algebra_comparison
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) (N : L.Modules)
    (hqc : N.IsQuasicoherent)
    (hsections : ∀ V : L.Opens, IsAffineOpen V →
      Module.Finite (L.presheaf.obj (op V)) (N.val.obj (op V)))
    (hdepth : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      ∃ hfinite : Module.Finite (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y),
        letI := hfinite
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y)
          (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y)) :
    let g := f ≫ U.ι
    let B : L.CommAlgebraSheaf := Under.mk
      (⟨g.c⟩ : L.sheaf ⟶ (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward CommRingCat.{u} g.base).obj X.sheaf)
    Nonempty (Modules.restrict N U.ι ≅ Modules.restrict B.toModule U.ι) →
    Nonempty (N ≅ B.toModule) ∧
      ∀ y : L,
        letI : Algebra (L.presheaf.stalk y)
            ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj B.right.obj) :=
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).map B.hom.hom).hom.toAlgebra
        Nonempty ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{u}) (X := L) N.val.presheaf y)
          ≃ₗ[L.presheaf.stalk y]
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor CommRingCat y).obj B.right.obj))

proof.text: Apply the general depth-two Hartogs restriction-adjunction unit theorem to N. Identify the actual algebra underlying module with the direct image of the structure module (definitionally), and use pushforwardComp to put it in the essential image of j_*. Full faithfulness of j_* gives invertibility of its unit. Push forward the supplied restriction isomorphism and compose the two units to obtain N isomorphic to the actual algebra underlying module.

For any commutative algebra sheaf B, preservation of filtered colimits by the forgetful functor from commutative rings to abelian groups gives the additive equivalence from the underlying module stalk to the ring-valued stalk. The colimit comparison sends germs to the same germs. Represent scalars and module elements on a common neighborhood and use the structure morphism and multiplication of germs to prove linearity. Bijectivity upgrades this linear map to a linear equivalence.

Apply the module stalk functor to the module isomorphism and compose its induced linear equivalence with the algebra stalk comparison at every point. Return the module isomorphism and these stalk equivalences.
